rationale: The only measured, workflow-relevant optimization in the evidence is P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads), with experiment results showing elapsed savings (e.g., 20.4% and 6.06%). However, this workflow already uses gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6, which the workflow itself describes as "the canonical Gradle cache for GitHub Actions." The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, so adding a separate actions/cache@v4 entry for ~/.gradle/caches would be redundant rather than beneficial. No other pattern fits without contraindication: there is no matrix for fail-fast, no runaway-job history justifying a custom timeout (and valid slow integration tests risk being cut off), and change-filtering/skip/cancellation patterns would alter required-check behavior whose status is not verified. Preserving existing build/test coverage, no supported change applies.
